Current target-test helper copies payload["sales_order"] into gate_carriers as raw whitespace after the route has stripped normalized_payload, and router source evidence then updates normalized_payload with gate_carriers before validation. This keeps the blank value from reaching the original 400 validation branch and remains adjustable inside the target test fixture/mock.
classification_rationale: The remaining 500 is caused by target-test fixture/mock carrier handling for the blank sales_order case. Evidence supports continuing inside the target test to adjust payload/mock shape and trigger the original 400 business-error branch.
